## Installation and setup

```{r}
#| label: install

devtools::install_github("role-model/roleR")
```

```{r}
#| label: setup

# load package as normal
library(roleR)

# only once after initial installation, we need to install python
# package `msprime` and its dependencies
installMsprime()
```



## Quick start

```{r}

# set-up parameters
p <- roleParams(
    individuals_local = 1000,
    individuals_meta = 1000000,
    species_meta = 20,
    speciation_local = 1e-05,
    speciation_meta = 4,
    extinction_meta = 3.8,
    trait_sigma = 2,
    env_sigma = 1,
    comp_sigma = 1,
    dispersal_prob = 0.05,
    mutation_rate = 1e-07,
    neut_delta = 1,
    env_comp_delta = 0,
    equilib_escape = 1,
    alpha = 2e+03,
    num_basepairs = 300,
    init_type = "oceanic_island",
    niter = 1000000,
    niterTimestep = 500000
)

# initialize the model
m <- roleModel(p)

# run the model
r <- runRole(m)

r@info

boo <- getLocalComm(r)
cbind(boo@spGenDiv, 
      boo@spTajD, 
      boo@spAbund, 
      boo@spAbundHarmMean)

plot(boo@spAbund, boo@spTajD)
plot(boo@spAbund, boo@spGenDiv)



t0 <- getPhylo(r, 1) |> as("phylo")
tt <- getPhylo(r) |> as("phylo")

plot(t0); axis(1)
plot(tt); axis(1)

(ape::node.depth.edgelength(t0) |> max()) - 
    (ape::node.depth.edgelength(tt) |> max())




# get results
getSumStats(r)
```
